# UE5 HTML5 Exporter v0.3.51

This release repairs the guided Vercel/Supabase deployment verification path for current Unreal exports.

- Hosted deployment verification now accepts the exporter’s current `ue5-html5-export/v7` manifest.
- The hosted verifier and package preflight share one supported-schema policy, preventing their schema allowlists from drifting again.
- The regression test probes the current schema directly while legacy-schema coverage remains intact.

The v0.3.50 browser runtime, Blueprint coverage, privacy boundary, and deployment contracts are otherwise unchanged. Native Win64 compilation on a real Windows UE 5.8 workstation and a live two-account Discord Activity run remain final external certification steps.
